author: kayanidev
title: Wingin’ It: Time Flies Fall Recruitment for Concept Artist and 3D Artists
content: 🍂WINGIN’ IT: TIME FLIES FALL RECRUITMENT IS OPEN! 🐣🎃 We’re expanding our team this fall! Wingin’ It: Time Flies is a stylized 3D adventure currently in active development, and as our world continues to grow, we’re looking for more artists, designers, and developers to join us in bringing it to life! OPEN ROLES • Concept Artist • UI Lead • Game Designers • Maya Riggers / Animation • Narrative Lead • 3D Artists This is a volunteer, portfolio-focused project where you’ll have the opportunity to collaborate with a multidisciplinary game team, contribute directly to a playable project, and create work you can showcase in your portfolio. Whether you want to design environments, help shape gameplay, develop the world and its characters, or bring our birds to life, we’d love to hear from you! 💛 Interested in joining the flock?🐣 Scan the QR code to apply! Feel free to share this with any artists or developers who might be interested. ✨ #GameDev #IndieGame #GameDesign #3DArtist #ConceptArt Contact: Scan QR code in post to apply.

author: imaginariumarts
title: Seeking ongoing paid artist for YouTube channel assets
content: ARTISTS AND DESIGNERS LISTEN UP!!! A pal of mine recently started his YouTube channel journey, and is seeking an ongoing artist to commission for assets! This guy REALLY loves to support real life human artists, and invests in human made work consistently!! He is really good people and really knows his shit. Detail update: seeking ongoing artist for main channel assets and “branded” designs, will rotate roster of thumbnail of various artists for features!! (See pinned comment for more!) ‼️ The bulk of the work would be for channel art with fast turnaround time for his video content, and wants HUMAN MADE not AI! ‼️ Some requests will be less complicated, like thumbnail artwork, but other requests may be more detailed or specific, so flexibility is KEY! ‼️ Preference given to those who can replicate Kirby style content and character drawing, but send your portfolios of comics art so he can see who’s out here! ‼️ You will be paid fair compensation, so be ready to send your rates for consideration along with your samples if requested! ‼️ Potential for additional work as needed down the line if it goes well! ‼️I promise he is legitimate and real and worthy of your time and effort, and is worth submitting your work to as he will be respectful and professional! ‼️Plus he’s got a wicked sense of humor and is very chill and good people, so you will have A REALLY GOOD TIME working with him I do declare. He’s added as contributor to this post, so he can go through the comments as you drop your info, so don’t be shy and introduce yourselves! Everyone is welcome to throw their hat into the ring if you wanna be considered for this very special YouTube channel! COMMENT BELOW AND LET’S SEE WHERE IT LEADS YALL! 🗯 NOTE FROM ELLEN — Let me know via DM if you want me to keep personally sending you opportunities if I come across them or someone needs a referral! #artistswanted #comicbookcommunity #commissionswelcome #artistsupportartists comicbookfan Contact: Comment on the post or DM @imaginariumarts
